issues.line_before: Raining down cascades of vajras, spears, wheels,fire, and entire mountains and glaciers—
issues.line_after: Raining down cascades of vajras, spears, wheels, fire, and entire mountains and glaciers—

issues.line_before: And broughtmeditation and wisdom to their culmination—
issues.line_after: And brought meditation and wisdom to their culmination—

issues.line_before: Homage to you, in whomthe perfections were complete.
issues.line_after: Homage to you, in whom the perfections were complete.

issues.line_before: Shines forthlike the light of the sun;
issues.line_after: Shines forth like the light of the sun;

issues.line_before: You are the true friend in whomI take refuge.
issues.line_after: You are the true friend in whom I take refuge.

issues.line_before: And the teacher of the godsowered like a fox.

issues.comment: Letter lost as well as the space: the teacher of the gods (Bṛhaspati) cowered like a fox. Needs a translator's confirmation.

issues.line_before: And many others of great renown —
issues.line_after: And many others of great renown—
issues.comment: Only spaced em dash in the text; everywhere else is closed (word—word).

issues.line_before: You accomplishedperfectly;to you I pay homage.
issues.line_after: You accomplished perfectly; to you I pay homage.

issues.line_before: OĀryāTārā, Mother of the Victors,
issues.line_after: O Āryā Tārā, Mother of the Victors,

issues.line_before: Recite the above mantra three times— to make the offering to the principal Lady.
issues.line_after: Recite the above mantra three times—to make the offering to the principal Lady.

issues.line_before: Recite this mantra, also, three times— to make the offering to all the guests.
issues.line_after: Recite this mantra, also, three times—to make the offering to all the guests.

issues.line_before: Until the heart of awakening,I rely on you for refuge!
issues.line_after: Until the heart of awakening, I rely on you for refuge!

issues.line_before: Lead my mindto virtue, O Noble Lady!
issues.line_after: Lead my mind to virtue, O Noble Lady!

issues.line_before: In every situation, quickly protect mefrom the eight or sixteen dangers—
issues.line_after: In every situation, quickly protect me from the eight or sixteen dangers—

issues.line_before: Help me to muster suchvast courage, O Noble Lady!
issues.line_after: Help me to muster such vast courage, O Noble Lady!

issues.line_before: Mergemy mind with the Dharma, O Noble Lady!
issues.line_after: Merge my mind with the Dharma, O Noble Lady!

issues.line_before: Show me mytrue nature, luminosity, with decisive recognition of the dhātu,
issues.line_after: Show me my true nature, luminosity, with decisive recognition of the dhātu,

issues.line_before: Let my pure perception ofthe emanation and dissolution of the maṇḍala be complete.
issues.line_after: Let my pure perception of the emanation and dissolution of the maṇḍala be complete.

issues.line_before: Guide me toBuddha Boundless Life and Light
issues.line_after: Guide me to Buddha Boundless Life and Light

issues.line_before: In the vast ocean of realms,whether there are buddhas or not,
issues.line_after: In the vast ocean of realms, whether there are buddhas or not,

issues.line_before: I may concentrate on meditation practicealone.
issues.line_after: I may concentrate on meditation practice alone.

issues.line_before: Who upholdit, O Noble Lady!
issues.line_after: Who uphold it, O Noble Lady!

issues.line_before: With the boundless halo ofyour stainless light,
